当前微课功能使用硬编码的 demo URL，所有题目都指向同一个地址。分析如下：

## 问题分析

### 1. 当前实现状态

在以下两个文件中，微课URL都是硬编码的demo地址：

```474:492:imates-web/src/views/ExerciseSolveView.vue
// 处理打开微课
const handleOpenMiniClass = (question: ExerciseItem) => {
  try {
    // 使用硬编码的微课URL
    const classUrl = 'https://www.imates.com.cn:9099/demo/demo1.html'
    
    if (!classUrl || classUrl.trim() === '') {
      showMessage('该题目暂无微课', 'warning')
      return
    }

    // 更新UI Store中的微课信息并打开弹框
    const questionTitle = question.title || question.question?.substring(0, 50) || ''
    uiStore.openMiniClassDialog(classUrl, questionTitle)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`[ExerciseSolveView] 打开微课失败:`, error)
    showMessage('打开微课失败', 'error')
  }
}
```

```1103:1119:imates-web/src/components/QuestionList.vue
// 打开微课（使用Web技术实现）
const openMiniClass = async (question: ExerciseItem) => {
  try {
    // 使用硬编码的微课URL
    const classUrl = 'https://www.imates.com.cn:9099/demo/demo1.html'

    if (!classUrl || classUrl.trim() === '') {
      showMessage('该题目暂无微课', 'warning')
      return
    }

    // 优先通过事件通知父组件（ExerciseSolveView）打开微课
    emit('openMiniClass', question)
  } catch {
    showMessage('打开微课失败', 'error')
  }
}
```

### 2. 问题根源

1. 类型定义缺少微课URL字段：`ExerciseItem` 接口中没有 `miniClassUrl` 或 `microClassUrl` 字段
2. 数据转换未映射微课URL：在 `questionStore.ts` 的数据转换过程中，没有映射微课URL字段
3. 后端API可能未返回微课URL：需要确认后端API是否返回该字段

### 3. 解决方案建议

#### 方案1：从题目数据中获取微课URL（推荐）

**步骤1**：在 `ExerciseItem` 接口中添加微课URL字段

```typescript
export interface ExerciseItem {
  id: string
  bmNo: string
  title: string
  question?: string
  answer: string
  explanation: string
  analysisData: string
  subject?: string
  miniClassUrl?: string  // 新增：微课URL字段
  
  // 显示相关属性
  atUserList?: boolean
  isAiGuiding?: boolean
  userSelect?: boolean
  beginGuideToSolve?: boolean
}
```

**步骤2**：在数据转换时映射微课URL字段

在 `questionStore.ts` 的 `fetchQuestions` 方法中，添加微课URL的映射：

```typescript
const convertedQuestions: ExerciseItem[] = questionList.map((q: unknown) => {
  const question = q as Record<string, unknown>
  return {
    id: (question.id as string) || (question.bmNo as string) || '',
    bmNo: (question.bmNo as string) || (question.id as string) || '',
    title: (question.title as string) || '',
    question: (question.content as string) || (question.question as string) || (question.title as string) || '',
    answer: (question.answer as string) || '',
    explanation: (question.explanation as string) || '',
    analysisData: (question.analysisData as string) || '',
    subject: (question.subject as string) || subject.toLowerCase(),
    miniClassUrl: (question.miniClassUrl as string) || (question.microClassUrl as string) || undefined,  // 新增
  }
})
```

**步骤3**：修改微课打开逻辑，从题目数据中获取URL

在 `ExerciseSolveView.vue` 中：

```typescript
const handleOpenMiniClass = (question: ExerciseItem) => {
  try {
    // 从题目数据中获取微课URL
    const classUrl = question.miniClassUrl || ''
    
    if (!classUrl || classUrl.trim() === '') {
      showMessage('该题目暂无微课', 'warning')
      return
    }

    const questionTitle = question.title || question.question?.substring(0, 50) || ''
    uiStore.openMiniClassDialog(classUrl, questionTitle)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`[ExerciseSolveView] 打开微课失败:`, error)
    showMessage('打开微课失败', 'error')
  }
}
```

在 `QuestionList.vue` 中：

```typescript
const openMiniClass = async (question: ExerciseItem) => {
  try {
    // 从题目数据中获取微课URL
    const classUrl = question.miniClassUrl || ''

    if (!classUrl || classUrl.trim() === '') {
      showMessage('该题目暂无微课', 'warning')
      return
    }

    emit('openMiniClass', question)
  } catch {
    showMessage('打开微课失败', 'error')
  }
}
```

#### 方案2：通过单独API获取微课URL

如果后端API不返回微课URL，可以通过单独API获取：

```typescript
const handleOpenMiniClass = async (question: ExerciseItem) => {
  try {
    // 如果题目数据中没有微课URL，通过API获取
    let classUrl = question.miniClassUrl || ''
    
    if (!classUrl) {
      const apiService = ApiService.getInstance()
      const miniClassData = await apiService.getMiniClassUrl(question.id, question.subject || 'math')
      classUrl = miniClassData.miniClassUrl || ''
    }
    
    if (!classUrl || classUrl.trim() === '') {
      showMessage('该题目暂无微课', 'warning')
      return
    }

    const questionTitle = question.title || question.question?.substring(0, 50) || ''
    uiStore.openMiniClassDialog(classUrl, questionTitle)
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`[ExerciseSolveView] 打开微课失败:`, error)
    showMessage('打开微课失败', 'error')
  }
}
```

### 4. 需要确认的事项

1. 后端API是否返回微课URL字段？字段名是 `miniClassUrl` 还是 `microClassUrl`？
2. 如果没有，是否需要新增API接口来获取微课URL？
3. 微课URL的格式是什么？是完整的URL还是相对路径？
